description: Source code implementing the Simple Management Protocol (SMP) for Zephyr OS, including request handling, error responses, and protocol translation functions.

methods.name: smp_translate_error_code
methods.description: Translates SMP v2 error code to legacy SMP v1 error code.

methods.name: cbor_nb_reader_init
methods.description: Initializes CBOR decoder state with a network buffer.

methods.name: cbor_nb_writer_init
methods.description: Initializes CBOR encoder state with a network buffer.

methods.name: smp_rsp_op
methods.description: Converts a request opcode to its corresponding response opcode.

methods.name: smp_make_rsp_hdr
methods.description: Constructs a response SMP header based on a request header.

methods.name: smp_read_hdr
methods.description: Reads and parses an SMP header from a network buffer.

methods.name: smp_write_hdr
methods.description: Writes an SMP header into a streamer's buffer.

methods.name: smp_build_err_rsp
methods.description: Builds an error response in CBOR format.

methods.name: smp_handle_single_payload
methods.description: Processes a single SMP request payload and generates a response.

methods.name: smp_handle_single_req
methods.description: Processes a single SMP request and generates a complete response.

methods.name: smp_on_err
methods.description: Transmits an SMP error response, freeing buffers.

methods.name: smp_process_request_packet
methods.description: Processes all SMP requests in an incoming packet, handling multiple requests.

methods.name: smp_add_cmd_err
methods.description: Adds an error code to a CBOR response for command error reporting.
